
            <h1 class="postTitle">

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">用 Apache SeaTunnel 同步 DynamoDB 到 Redis，一个配置文件就够</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        这个任务的挑战在哪呢？如何在不大写一堆代码的情况下，让两边保持同步？
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>作者：Ricardo Ferreira<br>
编译：Debra Chen</p>
<p>假设你把客户数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中，作为应用的唯一数据源（single source of truth）。但如今你需要同样的数据放在 Redis 里，进行快速缓存、实时分析，或是为向量搜索推荐引擎赋能。举例来说，DynamoDB 中这张名为 <code>mySourceTable</code> 的表当前包含两条数据记录。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3195851/202609/3195851-20260902145155710-759131565.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>那么这个任务的挑战在哪呢？如何在不大写一堆代码的情况下，让两边保持同步？</p>
<p>就我个人而言，我最理想的方案是使用 <strong>Redis Data Integration（RDI）</strong>，但遗憾的是，在撰写本文时，RDI 还不支持把 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据源。这就让开发者只剩下两个选择：自己编写复杂的数据集成管道，或者投入昂贵（而且往往溢价过高）的 ETL 解决方案。这两个选项都不怎么让人满意。</p>
<p>但还有另一条路。</p>
<p>那就是 <strong>Apache SeaTunnel</strong>——一个开源数据集成项目，它让数据同步变得像写一个配置文件一样简单。在这篇博客中，我会深入介绍这个项目，并一步步讲解如何把数据从 Amazon DynamoDB 同步到 Redis。</p>
<h2 id="apache-seatunnel你的开源数据管道好帮手">Apache SeaTunnel：你的开源数据管道好帮手</h2>
<p>Apache SeaTunnel 是一个多模态、高性能、分布式的海量数据集成工具，同时支持批处理和流式两种模式。你可以把它想象成你数据系统的"万能翻译官"——它精通 DynamoDB、Redis 以及其他 100 多种数据系统。</p>
<p>在这个场景下，SeaTunnel 的突出优势在于：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>零代码</strong>：用简单的配置文件即可定义你的数据管道</li>
<li><strong>分布式</strong>：当数据增长时，同步可横向扩展</li>
<li><strong>容错</strong>：内置 checkpoint 机制，确保数据不丢失</li>
</ul>
<p>你可以用两种不同的配置方式使用 SeaTunnel：<strong>单机模式</strong>（standalone），用于一次性的数据搬运；或者<strong>集群模式</strong>（cluster），它能搭建一套常驻在线的数据管道基础设施，随时准备执行新任务。</p>
<h3 id="方案一快速上手单机模式">方案一：快速上手（单机模式）</h3>
<p>这个方案非常适合一次性迁移、本地开发或定时批处理任务。一条命令，搞定一切。</p>
<p>第一步，创建你的管道配置文件（<code>jobs/my.config</code>）：</p>
<pre><code>env {
  parallelism = 1
  job.mode = "BATCH"
}
source {
  Amazondynamodb {
    url = "http://dynamodb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
    region = "us-east-1"
    access_key_id = "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY"
    secret_access_key = "YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
    table = "mySourceTable"
    schema = {
      fields {
        customerId = int
        customerName = string
        address = string
      }
    }
  }
}
sink {
  Redis {
    host = host.docker.internal  # 或者你的 Redis 主机地址
    port = 6379
    support_custom_key = true
    key = "customer:{customerId}"
    data_type = hash
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>用一条 Docker 命令即可运行：</p>
<pre><code>docker run --rm -it \
  -v $(pwd)/jobs:/config \
  apache/seatunnel:2.3.12 \
  ./bin/seatunnel.sh -m local -c /config/my.config
</code></pre>
<p>这条命令会启动一个新容器，里面运行一个单机模式 SeaTunnel 实例，执行 <code>my.config</code> 文件中描述的任务。你会看到类似下面的输出：</p>

<p>任务执行完成后，用于执行它的 Docker 容器会被终止，此时你就能在 Redis 中看到写入的数据记录了。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3195851/202609/3195851-20260902145155678-1235224439.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>正如 SeaTunnel 官方所说，整个过程简单到只需写一个配置文件。当然，要真正吃透 source 和 sink 连接器提供的众多配置项，可能还需要花些时间。你可以点击<a href="https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.12/connector-v2/source/AmazonDynamodb/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">此处</a>查看 Amazon DynamoDB 的配置属性，点击<a href="https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.12/connector-v2/sink/Redis/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">此处</a>查看 Redis 的配置属性。</p>
<h3 id="方案二生产级引擎集群模式">方案二：生产级引擎（集群模式）</h3>
<p>当你需要一套常驻在线的数据管道基础设施，能够处理多个任务、按需扩容，并提供 REST API 访问时，集群模式就是你的选择。</p>
<h4 id="第一步搭建基础设施">第一步：搭建基础设施</h4>
<p>创建一个 <code>docker-compose.yaml</code>，拉起一个完整的 SeaTunnel 集群。它同时也会带上 Redis——在这个用例里，Redis 是数据管道的目标端（sink）。</p>
<pre><code>version: '3.8'
services:
  seatunnel-master:
    image: apache/seatunnel:2.3.12
    container_name: seatunnel-master
    environment:
      - ST_DOCKER_MEMBER_LIST=172.16.0.3,172.16.0.4,172.16.0.5
    volumes:
      - ./config/hazelcast-master.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/hazelcast-master.yaml
      - ./config/seatunnel.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/seatunnel.yaml
    entrypoint: &gt;
      /bin/sh -c "
      /opt/seatunnel/bin/seatunnel-cluster.sh -r master
      "
    ports:
      - "5801:5801"
      - "8080:8080"  # REST API 端点
    networks:
      seatunnel_network:
        ipv4_address: 172.16.0.3
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/system-monitoring-information || exit 1" ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 60s

  seatunnel-worker1:
    image: apache/seatunnel:2.3.12
    container_name: seatunnel-worker1
    environment:
      - ST_DOCKER_MEMBER_LIST=172.16.0.3,172.16.0.4,172.16.0.5
    volumes:
      - ./config/hazelcast-worker.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/hazelcast-worker.yaml
      - ./config/seatunnel.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/seatunnel.yaml
    entrypoint: &gt;
      /bin/sh -c "
      /opt/seatunnel/bin/seatunnel-cluster.sh -r worker
      "
    depends_on:
      - seatunnel-master
    networks:
      seatunnel_network:
        ipv4_address: 172.16.0.4
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f seatunnel || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 45s

  seatunnel-worker2:
    image: apache/seatunnel:2.3.12
    container_name: seatunnel-worker2
    environment:
      - ST_DOCKER_MEMBER_LIST=172.16.0.3,172.16.0.4,172.16.0.5
    volumes:
      - ./config/hazelcast-worker.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/hazelcast-worker.yaml
      - ./config/seatunnel.yaml:/opt/seatunnel/config/seatunnel.yaml
    entrypoint: &gt;
      /bin/sh -c "
      /opt/seatunnel/bin/seatunnel-cluster.sh -r worker
      "
    depends_on:
      - seatunnel-master
    networks:
      seatunnel_network:
        ipv4_address: 172.16.0.5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f seatunnel || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 45s

  redis-database:
    container_name: redis-database
    hostname: redis-database
    image: redis:8.4.0
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    networks:
      seatunnel_network:
        ipv4_address: 172.16.0.2
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "redis-cli ping | grep PONG" ]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s
      timeout: 5s
networks:
  seatunnel_network:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.16.0.0/24
</code></pre>
<h4 id="第二步配置集群">第二步：配置集群</h4>
<p>创建 <code>config/seatunnel.yaml</code> 以启用 REST API：</p>
<pre><code>seatunnel:
  engine:
    http:
      enable-http: true
      port: 8080
</code></pre>
<p>创建 <code>config/hazelcast-master.yaml</code> 和 <code>config/hazelcast-worker.yaml</code>：</p>
<pre><code>hazelcast:
  network:
    rest-api:
      enabled: true
      endpoint-groups:
        CLUSTER_READ:
          enabled: true
        CLUSTER_WRITE:
          enabled: true
        HEALTH_CHECK:
          enabled: true
        DATA:
          enabled: true
    port:
      auto-increment: true
      port-count: 100
      port: 5801
    join:
      tcp-ip:
        enabled: true
        member-list:
          - 172.16.0.3
          - 172.16.0.4
          - 172.16.0.5
</code></pre>
<h4 id="第三步启动集群">第三步：启动集群</h4>
<pre><code>docker compose up -d
</code></pre>
<p>现在你的 SeaTunnel 集群已运行，包含：</p>
<ul>
<li>1 个 Master 节点（协调器 + API 服务器）</li>
<li>2 个 Worker 节点（实际执行数据管道）</li>
<li>Redis 数据库（你的 sink 和目标系统）</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="第四步通过-rest-api-提交任务">第四步：通过 REST API 提交任务</h4>
<p>接下来是见证奇迹的时刻！用一条简单的 HTTP POST 提交任务：</p>
<pre><code>curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/submit-job?jobName=dynamodb-to-redis \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
 "env": {
 "parallelism": 2,
 "job.mode": "BATCH"
 },
 "source": [
 {
 "plugin_name": "Amazondynamodb",
 "plugin_output": "dynamodb_source",
 "url": "http://dynamodb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com",
 "region": "us-east-1",
 "access_key_id": "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY",
 "secret_access_key": "YOUR_SECRET_KEY",
 "table": "mySourceTable",
 "schema": {
 "fields": {
 "customerId": "int",
 "customerName": "string",
 "address": "string"
 }
 }
 }
 ],
 "transform": [],
 "sink": [
 {
 "plugin_name": "Redis",
 "host": "redis-database",
 "port": 6379,
 "support_custom_key": true,
 "key": "customer:{customerId}",
 "data_type": "hash"
 }
 ]
}'
</code></pre>
<p>任务一旦提交，就会立刻开始执行。你可以在 SeaTunnel 提供的 Web 控制台里跟进任务执行情况：访问 <code>http://localhost:8080/#/overview</code>，然后切换到 <code>Jobs</code> 标签页。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3195851/202609/3195851-20260902145155660-1105356348.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>有了 Apache SeaTunnel，把数据从 Amazon DynamoDB 同步到 Redis 就变成了一件"配置"层面的工作。无论你需要一次性迁移，还是一套常驻在线的数据集成管道，Apache SeaTunnel 都有满足你需求的工具。</p>
<p>使用 SeaTunnel 的妙处在于：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>无需维护代码</strong>——只需简单配置即可使用</li>
<li><strong>久经实战检验的连接器</strong>——专注于你的业务逻辑</li>
<li><strong>部署灵活</strong>——无论是笔记本还是生产集群都能跑</li>
<li><strong>天生可扩展</strong>——可随数据增长横向扩容</li>
</ul>
<p>准备好试一试了吗？建议先用单机模式快速实验一下，等要上生产时再升级到集群模式。</p>
<ul>
<li>本地模式部署：<a href="https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/locally/deployment" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/locally/deployment</a></li>
<li>Docker 部署：<a href="https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/docker/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/docker/</a></li>
<li>kubernetes 部署：<a href="https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/kubernetes/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://seatunnel.apache.org/docs/2.3.13/getting-started/kubernetes/</a></li>
</ul>
